raw_response:
This little plot near my home has my perennials — I keep enset and some fruit, and I plant other things between them. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this kind of plot; instead I put household manure and ash around the plants, that is what my family has always done. The plants are already growing from before, so there is no new seed to buy, and I do not have money for sprays. My wife and I look after it ourselves through the season, weeding and digging when needed.
